title: ENDEX: 10:00 Thursday, Water Gone, Units Holding on 6 and 7 West

fields.resolution: ENDEX. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. It is 10:00 CDT on Thursday, September 17, 2026. The surge crested at 22 inches overnight and has drained off the ground floor. Winds dropped below 34 knots around 02:00, and Facilities began inspecting the ED, pharmacy and imaging at 04:00. Command has drafted a phased plan to return the NICU to floor 2 and the ICU to floor 3 once the inspection is signed off. This ends play.
finalState: The ED stays on floor 2. The pharmacy IV room runs from a temporary area until cleanup and verification are finished.
The NICU correction is on the hospital website and went out through Nueces County OEM. The delayed pip-tazo dose for 6 West bay 12 was given and the family disclosure is documented.
One generator elevator is still out of service. The elevator tech is waiting for the bridge to reopen, and TxDOT is still inspecting the causeways.
NICU (7 West) and ICU (6 West) are holding at 1:3, with 1:1 for vented infants, using reassigned ride-out staff until Gulf Nurse Staffing relief can cross.
The return-to-unit plan uses the same step-by-step moves, receiving-nurse acceptance and structured handoffs as the vertical evacuation.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. That ends play. Put down your radios, phones and tracking boards, and leave your notes and paper MARs on the table. Take ten minutes, then come back to the main table for the hot wash. Leave your roles behind and speak freely.
fields.hotWashMethod: Timeline walk-back, then 3-Up, 3-Down: walk the H clock from the 06:00 Tuesday advisory to landfall night. Each role then names three things that worked and three things that broke.
hotWashQuestions: When H moved from 18:00 to 12:00 Wednesday, how did command recalculate the H minus 12 deadline, and what information was still missing at the midnight shelter-or-evacuate decision?

How well did Vertical Evacuation Phase 1 run against the 90-minute NICU and 3-hour ICU targets? Who decided the exceptions to the priority list (Bed 2 ahead of Bed 6, 3-07 and 3-14, the twins), and where were those decisions recorded?

The Bed 4 handoff missed the vancomycin allergy and the pending culture, the stairwell pump died, and the bay 12 dose was late. What checks would have caught each one, and was disclosure made within 60 minutes?
How fast and how accurately did we answer the Houston rumors, the reporters and the families? Who owned the message?
What has to be true before the NICU goes back to floor 2 and the ICU goes back to floor 3: inspection sign-off, elevators, staffing ratios and patient tracking reconciliation?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect the unit tracking boards, the master board, the downtime MARs, the handoff cards and the evaluator sheets before the break. Write down the actual 00:00 decision and the Phase 3 decisions so the timeline walk-back matches what the room did.
